text:
Leah M.: FYI I opened a PR to update the model-catalog entries for the new q4/q8 quantized builds and added a short migration guide for SDK v2. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5021
Diego F.: sweet. can we also drop a short compatibility matrix row about streaming + function-calls for q variants? customers ask about that a lot.
Leah M.: yep adding a 1-line table: q-variants | streaming: limited | function-calls: partial. Keeping it conservative.
Priya S.: heads-up the current model-card uses the old sample CLI `ri api text` - needs to switch to `ri text generate` in the snippets. I'll update examples in the PR.
Leah M.: thanks, please also add SNIPPET_START / SNIPPET_END markers so CI can include them. ci-bot has been strict about that.
bench-bot: new benchmark upload received: aether-7b-q8 - a100-40gb - fp16/q8 - batch sizes [1,8,16] - median p95 32ms/60ms/75ms respectively. CSV: s3://bench-uploads/5021/aether7b_q8.csv
Diego F.: good data. For the catalog table use median p95 and include instance column. also call out recommended batch <=16 for stable latency.
Priya S.: drafting the migration blurb: "To migrate from unpinned names (e.g., `aether-7b-q8`) to pinned variant versions, use the `@` suffix: `aether-7b@q8-2026-01-15`. Pinning avoids silent compatibility changes."
Leah M.: nice wording. Also include a one-line note: "8-bit KV support is experimental; performance and feature parity may vary."
docs-bot: linkcheck: /model-catalog/aether-7b -> 404 (branch: leah/quantized-catalog).
Priya S.: I moved the examples dir, forgot to update relative link. fixing now.
ci-bot: docs build failed - missing snippet marker: `SNIPPET_START:cli-q-migrate` in model-card/aether-7b.md.
Leah M.: adding marker and small CLI snippet now:\n\n```
# Migrate CLI example
# old
ri api text --model aether-7b-q8 --prompt "Hello"

# new (pin variant)
ri text generate --model aether-7b@q8-2026-01-15 --input "Hello"
```

Diego F.: can we also include a tiny SDK snippet for Node + Python? just minimal.
Priya S.: added both. Python example uses `client.text.generate(...)` and Node uses `client.text.generate(...)` as well. kept outputs trimmed.
bench-bot: uploaded updated CSV after snippet fix: s3://bench-uploads/5021/aether7b_q8_v2.csv
Leah M.: reworked the compatibility table row to read: "Quantized variants: reduced support for streaming long sequences; function-calls may behave differently for large payloads. Pin model version to ensure stable behavior."
Priya S.: also added a small note under "Limits": max sequence 4096, recommended batch <=16, max tokens response 2048.
docs-bot: preview deployed at https://deploy-preview--docs.redwood.ai/model-catalog/aether-7b (branch: leah/quantized-catalog)
Priya S.: preview looks OK. CI still complains about a broken internal link from the migration guide to /sdk/migration (absolute path).
Leah M.: changing to relative link. pushing now.
ci-bot: build passed (job #2367) on branch leah/quantized-catalog.
Leah M.: OK I'll merge after Diego verifies phrasing for the compatibility row.
Diego F.: quick pass done, minor grammar tweak pushed to the branch. looks good. merge when ready.
Leah M.: merged and backported the snippet markers to the 2.1 branch. Closing this thread. :tada:
